<!--
Research issues are used to compile research and discussion for a major development decision.
Typically, a single necessary decision should be determined, then research useful for making that decision outlined.

Questions to be answered are defined in this issue body and new questions can be added as needed.
Researched information, discussion, and decision-making take place in the comments.
After answers are decided on, they are added as nested bullets under the question.
Finally, a decision is made.

If you don't know how to use markdown, make sure and use the "Preview" tab at the top to check how your report will look before you submit.
-->
